heading: Rules and regulations
lead: The Secretary of the Interior is authorized to make rules and regulations for carrying out the provisions of this chapter.

notes.text: Transfer of Functions Transfer of functions to Secretary of Commerce from Secretary of the Interior by Reorg. Plan No. 4 of 1970, eff. Oct. 3, 1970, 35 F.R. 15627, 84 Stat. 2090, see note set out under section 777 of this title.
